body.purpose: Paragraph copy, Text Muted color, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Language-toggle pill only; the sole mono UI chrome.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.6rem; background: #f5792a; color: #14120f; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-cta:hover { background: #ff9248; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5792a; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost CTA
components.description: Secondary action (guide PDF, Boosty support link).
components.css: .ds-cta-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.6rem; background: transparent; color: #f2f1ee; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-cta-ghost:hover { background: #18150f; border-color: #f5792a; color: #f2f1ee; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Elevated container for the download picker and feedback form.

components.name: How-it-works card
components.description: Feature card with a real product screenshot in a plain bordered frame, a title, and a one-line description.
components.html:
Floating shelf

A row of your own command buttons right over the 3D viewport.
components.css: .ds-how-card { background: #18150f; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-how-card:hover { border-color: #3c3630; } .ds-how-figure { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; background: #0d0b0a; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.9rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 140px; } .ds-how-title { color: #f2f1ee; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; } .ds-how-body { color: #99989f; font-size: 0.92rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text input
components.description: Text field / select used in the download and feedback forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font: inherit; color: #f2f1ee; background: #0d0b0a; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #f5792a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5792a; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Language toggle
components.description: Signature bilingual RU/EN pill control in the sticky header; the site's only mono-labeled chrome.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #99989f; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 999px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { color: #f2f1ee; border-color: #f5792a; }

narrative.overview: A precise, warm-neutral dark page in the Linear/Raycast/Vercel register: one disciplined accent color, a coherent bilingual type family, hairline borders, and real product screenshots in plain frames do the persuading. There is no theme metaphor (no blueprint/schematic device, no Maya-shelf visual pun) — the world is the craft bar itself, played straight. This explicitly replaces a discarded dark-orange/Hanken-Grotesk execution that the owner named as anti-reference. IBM Plex Sans/Mono was chosen specifically to render Latin and Cyrillic as one coherent family, since the site is fully bilingual (RU/EN, equally primary) and the prior font's weak Cyrillic support was the owner's original complaint.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral near-black ground, never pure black or cool-gray
A single committed accent, used at CTA/wordmark/focus-ring/selection weight only — never scattered as chips or multiple tinted accents
Hairline 1px borders throughout; no heavy shadows, no gradients
Real product screenshots in plain 1px-bordered frames, never fake device chrome
No kicker/eyebrow labels above headings anywhere on the page

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: --accent is the only saturated color on the page. It appears at CTA/wordmark/focus/selection moments only; it never tints a card background, an icon, or a body of text.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section and card headings are never preceded by an eyebrow/kicker label. A kicker treatment was built and removed during this redesign for violating the craft floor; it is a defect the build once carried, not a system element — do not reintroduce it on future surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat-Ladder Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a background-color step (Ground -> Elevated Surface) plus a 1px border, never a box-shadow. This system carries no hard-offset shadow of any kind — not even the neobrutalist kind — because the world is a restrained dev-tool page, not a neobrutalist one.

dos: Do keep the accent to CTA / wordmark-accent / focus-ring / selection moments only (The One Accent Rule).
Do use IBM Plex Sans for all UI text and IBM Plex Mono only for the language-toggle control, to keep the mono face legible as "this is a control."
Do frame every product screenshot in a plain 1px-bordered box (.hero-shot, .how-card figure) at Ground or Elevated Surface background — never a fake browser/device chrome.
Do step elevation with background-color + border only (Ground -> Elevated Surface -> Border-Strong on hover); never introduce a box-shadow.
Do carry data-ru/data-en (and the -href-/-src- variants) on any new translatable element; do not hardcode a single-language string on new surfaces.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading — this was built, then removed for violating the craft floor's explicit ban; it is not a system element to reintroduce.

Don't add gradient text or a gradient fill anywhere; none exists in the shipped system and the direction contract calls for typographic hierarchy and whitespace to carry the design, not decorative gradients.
Don't add hard-offset/neobrutalist shadows or any box-shadow; this is a flat-ladder system, not a neobrutalist one.
Don't add a second saturated accent color or use the accent as a background fill outside CTA/wordmark contexts.
Don't consume --bg-elevated-2 for a new "third surface" without a real nested-elevation need — it's currently an unused reserved token, not an established third step.
